title: I put AI agents directly into a trading chart to automate orders/alerts on anything I draw.
author: Obside_AI
selftext:
Hi everyone!  
  
On top of testing and building automated strategies, I still like to watch the markets and establish trade scenarios based on a discretionary approach. 

The problem is: if I'm not in front of the chart when something interesting happens, then I'm missing opportunities.

So I built what I call a "Smart Chart", that can see what I add to it (indicators, lines, zones, Fibs, etc). I just then prompt what action I want an AI agent to take based on conditions I set.

It works with multi timeframe analysis and multiconditional setups. 

I'm currently working on agents tied to an entire watchlist (e.g. Alert me if any stock in my watchlist drops more than 4% in a day and prints a bullish RSI divergence on the H1 chart).

Curious to discuss other use cases of AI agents to assist traders that still analyze charts manually.

Cheers!

comments.author: chadiusmaximus
comments.body: Nice! I had a very similar idea not too long ago- drawing on a chart and having an agent buy on a set of conditions based on what I place on the chart. Like drawing a trend line and buying if it breaks trend with volume.

replies.author: Obside_AI
replies.body: Hi! Right, that's exactly one of the use cases. Not all traders have a systematic way of analyzing charts, but they should still be able to automate part of their trading :)

comments.author: CarryMinute7457
comments.body: Seems interesting. Can u tell how did you setup and train the bots to see this?

replies.author: Obside_AI
replies.body:
No training involved actually. Each agent is a small rule-based program, not a model that learns from data.

How it works on the Smart Chart:

1. You draw on the chart (a trend line, a zone...) or add an indicator.
2. You describe in plain English what the agent should do, (e.g. “if a 4h candle closes below this trend line, alert me and sell half”).
3. An AI writes the agent's code from that sentence. The code is checked, then it runs on every new candle.

I hope I was clear enough :)
